name: milton-errors
description: Log entries at severity ERROR or higher from the milton-app, milton-mcp and milton-auth Cloud Run services (request, application, system and audit logs). Read by the milton-<service> page policies and the release gate.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=("milton-app" OR "milton-mcp" OR "milton-auth") AND severity>=ERROR
